# KOGNIX

> Enterprise Generative AI by VAI LABs — secure, on-premise, fully integrated. Transformative AI with absolute data security and flexible integration.

## Products

- [KOGNIX AI Studio](/kognix-ai-studio): No-code studio to build, customize, and deploy enterprise AI assistants.
- [KOGNIX GenAI Engine (KAIE)](/kaie): Core generative AI engine that runs entirely within your infrastructure.
- [KOGNIX Analytics (Observability)](/observability): Monitoring, evaluation, and observability for AI workloads.
- [KOGNIX Intelligence](/kognix-intelligence): Decision intelligence and agentic workflows across the enterprise.
